title: Closet work, wages and his stepfather going independent
summary: He loved the work, did closets and bathrooms for 75 cents a day, and the stepfather decided to find his own contracts.

story.theme_name: Growing up and learning music: family, first instruments, teachers

blocks.x: And- So you could put your own clothes closets?
Yeah, I was small, you know, get around in a bedroom.

And man, I'd wipe those closets out and them bathrooms out too big for hurry. So my stepdaddy, he told mother, I had to tell mother one night, he said, boy, it's working too good for 75 cents a day. He said, I'm gonna see if I try to get some more work for myself.
Did you like it? Always have? Or did you ever get sick of it or something?
That's good. And he said, boy, it's working too good for six minutes a day. He said, and if anybody should benefit by it, he says, it's me.

He said, because he's here and he's like my own son. We're taking care of this. If anybody else benefit by it, it's me. My mama said, you're right. He said, what you're gonna do if you haven't got enough? He said, I'm gonna get something else to do or something. Get around my old contract that's been working for. Tell him I'm in business. So, sure enough, he got a fellow by the name of Jimmy Gazan. He was a big contractor around. No, I don't know. So, he had to work for Jimmy Gazan in about 15 years. And so, he went to Jimmy Gazan.
